sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName WHERE {
  ?tcamp rc:affects ?tvar ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp .
  ?tvar rc:ofModel ?tmodel .
  ?tmodel rc:name "TELLURIDE" ; rc:ofMake ?kia .
  ?kia rc:name "KIA" .
  ?comp skos:broader ?parent .
  ?gcamp rc:affectsComponent ?comp ; rc:affects ?gvar .
  ?gvar rc:ofModel ?gmodel .
  ?gmodel rc:ofMake ?genesis ; rc:name ?modelName .
  ?genesis rc:name "GENESIS" .
}
ORDER BY ?modelName
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?count) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?init . FILTER(CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?init)), "ODI") || CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?init)), "NHTSA")) }

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?year) AS ?yearCount) WHERE { ?make a rc:Make ; rc:name "HYUNDAI" . ?model a rc:VehicleModel ; rc:ofMake ?make ; rc:name "SONATA" . ?variant rc:ofModel ?model ; rc:modelYear ?year . ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?variant . }
